readout_other: performance- versus environment-dependent probability choice task; resting-state fMRI functional connectivity before and after TUS
direction_notes: Bilateral TUS of area 45a reduced choice of the performance-dependent option and TUS of 47/12o impaired environment-probability judgements (double dissociation); functional connectivity of the sonicated areas decreased after TUS.

device.model: NeuroFUS CTX-250 four-element annular array, driven by TPO-105

timing.protocol_description: Duty cycle 30%; pulse length 30 ms; pulse repetition interval 100 ms; total stimulation duration 40 s. All targets were sonicated bilaterally for 60 s in total, with 30 s of stimulation applied to a target from each hemisphere, immediately followed by the homologous contralateral target in pseudo-random order; behaviour was tested straight after sonication, with 24 h between sessions.
